position_sizing.conditional_logic: Money Management with Recovery (MMRec): after consecutive losses, lot size is increased by a recovery multiplier to recoup losses; after a win, lot size resets to base. Negative input values may indicate fixed lots, positive values may indicate fractional deposit percentage.

custom_logic_notes: The Ang_Zad_C custom indicator is central to this EA's logic and must be available for the EA to function. The MMRec (Money Management Recovery) system increases lot sizes after losses in an attempt to recover, which is a modified martingale approach with capped recovery steps. The 'Tm' in the name suggests time-based filtering is applied to restrict trading to specific sessions. The 'C' variant likely refers to a specific configuration of the Ang_Zad indicator. Signal reversal closes opposite positions before entering new ones.
python_conversion_notes: The Ang_Zad_C custom indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or ported separately to Python since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The indicator source (.mq5) should be located and its calculation logic translated. The MMRec recovery lot sizing logic requires tracking consecutive losses and computing recovery lot sizes - this state must be maintained across trades. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated. Time filter logic needs session-aware implementation. The EA processes signals once per new bar (new_bar_guard), so the Python version should use bar-level processing with intrabar tick data only for entry timing.
